verdict.rationale: Community threads about the BSD+patents license controversy and Facebook's relicensing to MIT implicitly reveal that React was (and remains) governed by a single company (Facebook/Meta) rather than a neutral foundation, giving developers some signal on lock-in risk, but there is no explicit first-party statement about governance structure or foundation status. Missing for 10: an official docs/governance page stating who controls the project (Meta vs. a foundation like OpenJS), any current foundation affiliation, and a clear continuity/roadmap statement.
